text:
Sam (CS): Heads-up: tenant 'verdant' goes live 10:00 PT. Need a tiny CSM one-pager (6 checkboxes) they can run in 8m: prefill, warm pool, jitter, batching hint, streaming fallback, and a single renewal_score mapping. Include copy/paste curl + JS + telemetry payload.
Ivy (Solutions): Draft 6-checklist idea: 1) Health check 2) 3 prefill probes 3) enable warm pool 30m 4) ramp policy 10/35/100% 5) start survey at +2h 6) verify telemetry tags & renewal_score.
Jordan (SRE): Healthcheck: GET /healthz?tenant=verdant must be 200. Prefill probes: POST /v1/prefill (3 distinct samples). Jitter: base=100ms + rand(0..150ms), retries=3. Warm pool = 30m.
Sam (CS): Add limit: "prefill per end-user <= 500 tokens" and a friendly line for customers: "label samples with environment: staging/prod".
Ivy (Solutions): Curl prefill (pasteable):
```bash
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/prefill \ 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' \ 
  -H 'X-Redwood-Prefill: 1' \ 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \ 
  -d '{"tenant":"verdant","samples":["Hi","Show my invoices"]}'
```
Ivy (Solutions): Tiny client snippet:```js
fetch('/v1/prefill',{method:'POST',headers:{'Authorization':'Bearer K','Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({tenant:'verdant',samples:['hello']})})
```
Nate (PM): Renewal scoring (single field `renewal_score` 0-100): start at 100, subtract 40 if 7d P95 latency >400ms, subtract 40 if 1h error_rate >1.5%, subtract 20 if negative feedback_count >=1 in first 48h. Score <=40 -> escalate to CSM+SRE. We'll wire cs-bot on score<=40.
Jordan (SRE): Streaming fallback rule: if stream connection resets within 6s, retry as sync generate with max_tokens=180 and header `X-Redwood-Fallback:stream->sync`. Emit event `fallback=stream_sync`.
Ivy (Solutions): Batching guidance (short): interactive UI -> batch_target 4; background workers -> batch 24. If observed tail latency rises above SLA, switch to small_batch_mode (batch=2) and enable kv-cache reuse.
Sam (CS): Survey to send at +2h: one-liner link "https://forms.redwood.ai/verdant-check". Add `survey_sent:true` to telemetry.
Ivy (Solutions): Telemetry example (single-line JSON we recommend to customers): {"event":"prefill_result","tenant":"verdant","renewal_score":"100","prefill_tokens":38,"latency_ms":132,"survey_sent":false}

Jordan (SRE): Ownership summary: CSM = runbook executor & customer follow-up; Solutions = payload samples & batching defaults; SRE = healthchecks/jitter/fallbacks; PM = renewal_score logic & dashboard alerting.
cs-bot: Alert rule created -> will DM @Sam when renewal_score<=40 :bell:
